description.value: A government-operated BCLIQUOR retail store located in the Whalley area of Surrey, part of the BC Liquor Distribution Branch's network of 198 stores province-wide. The store offers an extensive selection of wine, spirits, beer, coolers, ciders, and non-alcoholic products, with knowledgeable staff available for food and beverage pairing recommendations. Touring cyclists passing through the King George Boulevard corridor can stock up on beverages here.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the Whalley (Surrey) BCLIQUOR store, contradicting the OSM community field which lists 'North Vancouver' — King George Boulevard in the Whalley area is in Surrey. The website content is a generic chain store locator page with no mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or cyclist amenities; all required criteria and most optional amenities remain null. The store is confirmed open and operational based on the live website.
